```plato
// The result of a 2D raycast. When Hit is false the remaining fields are
// meaningless. Distance is measured from the ray origin along its
// direction; Normal points against the ray (out of the struck primitive);
// PrimitiveIndex identifies the struck primitive in the caller's list,
// -1 when inapplicable.
type RayHit2D
    implements IValue
{
    Hit: Boolean;
    Distance: Number;
    Position: Point2D;
    Normal: Direction2D;
    PrimitiveIndex: ItemIndex;
}
```
